scope: Full Eat Clean admin route, including its parent bootstrap and private cached catalog.
finding: AdminEatCleanPage called listEatCleanAdminData on every mount and blocked all tabs on its completion or seeded state. Dispatch then independently called listEatCleanDispatchData, duplicating order/config hydration and unnecessarily loading menu/inventory.
changes: Dispatch mounts directly and owns its existing authorized event/GPS workspace. The parent does not request or render unrelated catalog totals on that tab.
Orders, menu, inventory and operations load the existing admin snapshot on first demand and reuse it until explicit refresh or mutation. Hover preloads code only.
Slow, unavailable or unseeded catalog data does not block dispatch or initialize business data automatically.
Concurrent unchanged reads and StrictMode replay share one pending request with per-consumer response fencing.
Post-mutation refresh starts a fresh read, fencing any response whose read began before the commit.
Account, role and demo changes reset the workspace. Authorization errors clear private totals; transient failures require explicit retry.

validation.coverage: Chrome and iPhone WebKit: idle, hover, refresh, tab reuse, slow/error/unseeded catalog, account/role changes, denied refresh and mutation/read race.
validation.regressionDetail: The broad run passed132/134. Two external-auth fixture controls were occluded after the real parent stylesheet loaded its modal backdrop. The tests now invoke that fixture control as an external auth event; both passed in the final20-case affected run. There is no product click-through workaround.

releaseOrder: Hold main changes while the separate Academy release owns the next window.
Integrate this frontend on the resulting main, require exact CI and public smoke; no backend redeploy for this isolated change.
remaining: Catalog tabs still share a full bounded admin snapshot. Splitting those non-dispatch tabs into server sections and adding cursors is separate work.
